CustomField.description: Frozen structured snapshot of the assessment, written ONCE by GtmReadoutModel at draft generation and never edited afterwards. It is the half of the readout that is measurement rather than prose: scores, the band ladders they were scored against, per-dimension provenance, capability gaps, estate figures and the horizon. gtmReadoutView renders the designed readout from this plus the approved prose. Frozen on purpose — a later recalibration of the score bands must not silently redraw an already-approved readout's ladder.
CustomField.label: Readout Data
